formula_in_pdf: mean of CC_b over pooled blocks B (functions, methods, classes)
sonarqube_definition: complexity: Cyclomatic complexity (sum over the component); functions: Functions
how_we_compute_the_pdf_version: radon cc per block, pooled over all tracked .py files, mean. complexity/functions from SonarQube gives only a rough per-function mean, not the PDF definition

formula_in_pdf: max of CC_b over pooled blocks B
sonarqube_definition: complexity: Cyclomatic complexity; file-level is the finest granularity exposed, no per-function values
how_we_compute_the_pdf_version: radon cc per block, maximum over pooled list

formula_in_pdf: Oman-Hagemeister MI per file, mean over files
sonarqube_definition: sqale_index: Total effort (in minutes) to fix all the issues...; sqale_rating: A-to-E rating based on the technical debt ratio
how_we_compute_the_pdf_version: radon mi per file, mean over files. SonarQube maintainability keys are remediation-effort based (technical debt), a different construct

formula_in_pdf: Pylint overall score, one run over all files; 4 import checks disabled
how_we_compute_the_pdf_version: pylint over all tracked .py files at once with import-error,no-name-in-module,wrong-import-position,ungrouped-imports disabled. SonarQube proxy: violations / ncloc * 1000 (issues per KLOC)

formula_in_pdf: source lines of code, summed over files
sonarqube_definition: ncloc: Non commenting lines of code
how_we_compute_the_pdf_version: radon raw sloc summed over .py files for the PDF number; SonarQube ncloc reported alongside (all languages, and Python only via ncloc_language_distribution)

sonarqube_definition: comment_lines: Number of comment lines; comment_lines_density: Comments balanced by ncloc + comment lines
how_we_compute_the_pdf_version: PDF version from radon: sum(comments)/sum(sloc)*100. SonarQube-derived PDF version: comment_lines / ncloc * 100 (NOT comment_lines_density, which is comment_lines/(ncloc+comment_lines)*100)

formula_in_pdf: sum over files of issues per severity
sonarqube_definition: vulnerabilities: Vulnerabilities; security_hotspots: Security Hotspots; software_quality_*_issues: issues by impact severity (all qualities)
how_we_compute_the_pdf_version: bandit per repo, counts by issue_severity summed. SonarQube security counts reported separately; severities are different scales and rule sets
